fields.description: Path: epic. Blurby on Android as a React Native app, distributed through Google Play open testing (owner 2026-11-03): all four reading modes (Page, Focus, Flow, Narrate), the synced library through BLURBY-SERVER-1 with offline books, Kokoro running on the phone with the exact word-table cursor behind a phone speed test (a failure returns to the owner), background playback, and an Android Auto media app from day 1 that browses books and starts, pauses and skips narration from the car screen. iOS, Apple CarPlay and server narration are out of scope. Supersedes the deferred Track C (APK-0 to APK-4) lane.
